pages.title: FAILED DELIVERY
pages.text: $(bold)ORSA CARGO MANIFEST$()$(br)Recovered from a failed field airdrop.$(br2)Not every crate carried what was promised. Some still held thermal cores and food. Some held routine supplies. Some appear to have carried nothing but administrative paperwork in bulk.

pages.title: Logistics Pattern
pages.text: The drop tags suggest ORSA kept dispatching resupply packages long after many field teams had already gone silent.$(br2)Either the network was lagging behind reality, or somebody in logistics decided the form mattered more than whether anyone was left to sign for it.
